answer: A real Sybil defense is a per-identity escrow burned on any dishonesty proof. Each agent parks collateral before it can claim work, and every finished task is logged on an ember ledger that binds the claim to that stake. One failed audit burns the escrow and ejects every identity sharing it, so a single operator cannot spread risk across clones. Each new vertex in the reputation graph costs full collateral, so address spam becomes a linear bill. The canyon between honest and fake cost closes.
